prose: Matt Presti is the current President of the University of Science & Philosophy, an organization dedicated to sharing the works of Walter and Lao Russell, and preserving their artistic legacy. In this episode we talk about the Walter Russell Museum that Matt helped create, the nature of the Higher Self, Imagination, balancing our inner polarities, the shadow, and much more.
ext: We talk "demons" (aka internally divided beings), sound healing, the co-opted musical counterculture, and a lot about music in general.
